title: Kit Store Graph — Root Snapshot + Ordered Semantic Operations
summary: 🧩 Persist one materialized kit graph (root snapshot) plus a single append-ordered semantic operation log. Checkpoints, drafts, and transactions are thin lifecycles over the same operation records (forwards/backwards pairs are derived when applying operations, not second-class persistence). Readable heads (wip / stage / authoritative) are pointers into checkpoint + draft state machines.

rootSnapshot.description: Exactly one canonical kit aggregate at a chosen revision; backbone TipState merges snapshot + applied operation suffix.
rootSnapshot.shape: Bundle field `rootSnapshot.kit` mirrors the portable kit DTO (types, designs, pieces, …) used by codegen and GraphQL kit resolvers.

semanticOpLog.description: Ordered array of persisted records: stable id, operation kind string, and JSON input payload (the same payload family as RS `operation` command inputs).
semanticOpLog.ordering: Total order is list order; replay is deterministic when operations are applied in sequence from the root snapshot.
semanticOpLog.inverseNote: Undo stacks store inverse operations or inverse inputs; either can be regenerated from snapshot+forward knowledge — stores may still persist inverse sequences for O(1) rollback.

checkpoint.wraps: Ordered semantic change groups; each group references operation ids from `semanticOpLog` (not embedded duplicate kit trees).

draft.wraps: Checkpoint pointer + ordered transactions; each transaction references operation ids in log order.

transaction.wraps: Ordered forward operation ids; backwards companion is derived or listed symmetrically like today’s `Change` entity.

graphqlSurface.summary: 🌐 `compose/graphql/schema.graphql` (SDL emitted from `compose/rs` async-graphql) exposes `Query.readableKitGraph(selector)` companion `wip`/`authoritative` shorthands, `Graph.{semanticOpLog,projectionFingerprint,rootSnapshotHash}`, lifecycle `semanticOpRecordIds` / `orderedTransactionIds` on checkpoint/draft/transaction/change, `Mutation.{*,backboneAttach,backboneDetach}` returning `Command` plus `SubscriptionRoot.commandSucceeded`, and `BackboneCapabilitySet` for dev JSON vs `.compose/` without SQL.

kitGraphEngine.summary: 🧩 RS `crate::kit_graph_engine`: external design [`Id`] maps once via `Kit.bind_external_design_id` → `DesignHandle` + `Arc<Design>`; pieces registered in `Design.piece_weak_by_external_id` (write-side `Id`→`Weak<Piece>` beside the `Vec`); `projection_fingerprint_for_kit` matches golden sorted-centers hash; `deterministic_semantic_diff` + async `apply_semantic_op_json` compute ephemeral diffs (not persisted); each `vcs::Graph` is a separate readable/writable state (e.g. wip vs authoritative).

attachableBackbones.summary: 🗄️ Native `crate::kit_backbone` + `worker::ChildRuntime::backbone`: `BackboneStoreKind::DEV_JSON` keeps one JSON file (`kind` `compose.kit_backbone.dev_json`, `semanticOpLog`, `connectionUri`, `persistence` notes); `LOCAL_DOT_COMPOSE` keeps `.compose/wip.db` / `staged.db` / `authoritative.db` / `conflicts.db` (+ `semantic_op_log` table) plus `blobs/` for `BLOBHASH.EXT` payload files; replay uses [`kit_graph_engine::apply_semantic_op_json`] identical to RAM-only apply (US-001 golden tests replay from persisted rows). Wasm builds error on attach.

devJsonFile.semanticOpLog: Each entry repeats `draftId`, `transactionId`, `kind` (e.g. `createdFixedPiece`), and `input` JSON matching bundle operation payloads.
devJsonFile.atomicRewrite: Write `target.json.tmp.compose-write` beside the target path, serialize the full document once, rename(2) over the target atomically.
devJsonFile.crashSafety: Completed writes are prev or next whole-json snapshot; tearing happens only on `.tmp`; readers ignore partial temp files.
devJsonFile.detachSemantics: Detach clears only the backbone handle (no persistence tail); [`Graph`] + kit materialization stay in memory (`clear_piece_projections_for_backbone_replay` happens only immediately before replay on attach).

localDotCompose.sqliteOpTable: `semantic_op_log(seq, draft_id, transaction_id, kind, input_json)` append-only replay order by seq.
localDotCompose.blobs: Payload blobs use `blobs/` + hexadecimal hash + `.EXT` filenames for large detached bytes referenced from operation payloads.
localDotCompose.routing: `connectionUri` should point at a workspace folder; `{uri}/.compose/` hosts the artefact dirs. `wip` child workers write `wip.db`; `auth`/`authoritative` workers write `authoritative.db`.
localDotCompose.detachSemantics: Same detach rule as JSON: backbone slot cleared; blobs + sqlite files untouched; graphs remain hydrated until mutated outside replay.
